input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: new venture redis-conf-check (redis.conf read the way Redis 7.0 does, with a parity run against a real redis-server 7.0.15)
errors: Commit trailer first carried another session's Claude-Session URL (copied from the pg-hba-check commit); amended before the push.
A heredoc that wrote a Node script containing rmSync was refused by the removal safety check; the runner now leaves its case directories in place instead of deleting them.

Several parity runs were wasted on harness bugs: probe writes turned protected mode's -DENIED into a reset; loglevel warning hid the 'Ready to accept connections' line; a unix socket path under the long scratchpad exceeded the 108-byte limit for both Redis and Node's connect.

doc_friction.issue: Nothing says the scratchpad path is ~90 characters, which breaks unix sockets (108-byte sun_path) for anything a run starts there; cost one full 800-case re-run.

run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes hands off after 100 s and says not to change tracked files until it ends; with GitHub runners healthy the same checks finish there sooner, so the local run mostly blocks writing the run record.

deviations.why: Stopped the detached run_workflow_locally.py once GitHub CI had runners, so the run record could be written; it had already found the one real failure (fragile entry guard in parity/compare.mjs), fixed in this PR.
deviations.did: Relied on GitHub check runs for the rest

goal: Ship a tool people use: a redis.conf checker grounded in the real server's behaviour.
notes: Explore idea: redis-conf-check, the fourth of the server-config readers (sshd_config, sudoers, pg_hba.conf), chosen because redis-server 7.0.15 was installed in the container so the engine could be checked against the real server instead of docs. The config table (178 settings) is generated from Redis 7.0.15's config.c; command names and ACL categories from COMMAND LIST / ACL CAT. Parity: 800 seeded files; 273 started, 429 stopped at a config line, 98 exited at start-up; 0 differences on start/message/line, 46,930 CONFIG GET values and 590 unauthenticated probes (remote, 127.0.0.1, socket). Parity found real engine bugs (aliases in CONFIG GET, tls-cluster forcing TLS setup, DEBUG/MODULE gated before ACL, MODULE LIST not gated, bind "" = no listener, missing IPv6 skipped, Ubuntu build refusing activedefrag, bind "" with a socket misreported as local-reachable); the repo's inherited-keys lint found two more (memory unit and client class lookups reaching Object.prototype). Local: run_venture_tests redis-conf-check pg-hba-check 2 suites 0 failed; pages.yml 6/6 run: steps ok; ventures-tests local run found the entry-guard lint, fixed. Next if it pays off: Redis 7.2/7.4 tables from the same generator, pasted ACL files, Valkey parity.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: read Redis 7.0 config/ACL source, build parser+access model, generated table, parity harness against a real server, page, guide, tests
